To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. nd excavation of delicate buried fiber optic cables and the removal of water and organic sludge from manhole systems. 3. nt • Shall include a hose support arm, boom, or equivalent mechanism capable of supporting and positioning hoses over the excavation area. • Shall include all trailer components required for safe towing, transport, and field operation. 3.6 Hoses, Tools, and Accessories • Shall include hoses, fittings, tooling, and accessories necessary for normal operation. • Shall include all pumps, controls, tanks, and associated components required for the system to perform its intended mission upon delivery. 3.7 Documentation • Shall include operator manuals, maintenance documentation, and warranty information at time of delivery. 4.
